item.title: Lights Out 1.0.0
item.description: - Keeps your Mac awake and its session unlocked, so UI-automation agents keep working through the night. - Lights Out turns every screen black and the backlight off (built-in, Apple and DDC monitors), while screenshots and screen recordings still see the real desktop. - Moving the real mouse or pressing a key brings the screen back; input from agents doesn't. - Goes dark on its own after a few minutes without you, toggles with ⌃⌥⌘L, and takes `lightsout://` commands from scripts.
